name: BigBrain
teaser: A library for adding extra logic layers to existing bot brains

name: Waypoints - Expanded Navmesh
teaser: Expand where bots can explore with full map navmesh coverage!

name: Server Value Modifier [SVM]
teaser: Swiss knife of SPT. Standalone extensive All-In-One Server mod that comes with User Interface and a huge variety of options

name: SAIN - Solarint's AI Modifications - Full AI Combat System Replacement
teaser: Bots that don't suck.

name: Amands's Graphics
teaser: Lighting and postprocessing overhaul

name: Dynamic Maps
teaser: Replaces the in-game map screen with actually useful maps with dynamic information!

name: Looting Bots
teaser: Add more life to the bots by enhancing looting behaviors letting them loot items, containers, and corpses!

name: WTT - Content Backport
teaser: The moment you've all been waiting for....

name: UI Fixes
teaser: Quality of life improvements and fixes for SPT

name: WTT - CommonLib
teaser: A modding utility library that eliminates boilerplate when adding custom items, quests, characters, and more to SPT

name: Questing Bots
teaser: You're no longer the only PMC running around placing markers and collecting quest items. The bots have transcended and are coming for you...

name: Fontaine's FOV Fix
teaser: Removes the FOV change on aiming by default, and lets you customize the FOV change amount. Has options for modifying FOV scale, view model FOV, ADS camera movement smoothing, and optional toggle zoom (like ARMA or DAYZ).

name: Skipper
teaser: A small client mod for conveniently skipping quests

name: Kaeno-TraderScrolling
teaser: Allows for side scrolling of the traders

name: WTT- Artem
teaser: In the T***** District, an ex-cultist wields uncanny dealmaking skills, intricate connections, and crafts deadly weapons.

name: Painter
teaser: Painter is a trader who sells unique weapon mods and gear. Also painted weapon parts (incl. whole weapons).

name: ACCURATE CIRCULAR RADAR
teaser: A radar mod that displays enemy locations and identifies various enemy types.

name: Ref - SPT Friendly Quests
teaser: Converted all the Arena specific quests for Ref into SPT quests. Rewards the same things as Live, with an added Lega Medal to each quest. Includes the sword unlock and secure container.

name: Tactical Gear Component
teaser: Adds a lot more unique gear and attachments for E*****************

name: Live Flea Prices
teaser: Keep your flea prices up to date with data processed from Tarkov.dev

name: WTT- Armory
teaser: The official weapons pack forged by the WTT developers & friends... Arm yourself accordingly...

name: UnityToolkit
teaser: A collection of Unity libraries for client modders to make writing efficient, allocation-free code easier.

name: Epic's All in One
teaser: An all in one expansion of the weapons and weapon parts of the game complete with the Badger trader.

name: Borkel's Realistic Night Vision Goggles (NVGs and T-7)
teaser: Now with new realistic NVG masks and natural light outside the tubes. I looked at real life NVGs and I tried to imitate them ingame. Customizable ingame (colors and everything).

name: APBS - Acid's Progressive Bot System
teaser: Fully customizable progression system. By default, all AI will level with you, have appropriate gear for their level, and might be a tad more dangerous due to their progression. Everyone has something worth stealing or scavenging!

name: Lots of Loot Redux
teaser: Tired of having barely any loot in your raids? Lots of Loot Redux aims to bring back that old T***** feeling from when loot wasn't so scarce. If you are a loot goblin then this mod is for you!

name: WTT - Pack 'n' Strap
teaser: Gear up with Pack 'n' Strap - the perfect combo of Small Cases and an ALL NEW battle belt module, for all your early-game adventures.

name: HollywoodFX
teaser: Make battles look cinematic and immersive by rebuilding almost every single impact and special effect from scratch. Realism is not the aim, but the mod doesn't go overboard.

name: Bosses Have Lega Medals
teaser: Bosses have a configurable chance to have Lega Medals in their pockets.

name: Ammo Stats
teaser: Now updated for 4.1.0+!

name: All The Clothes
teaser: ALL THE CLOTHES FOREVER

name: ABPS - Acid's Bot Placement System
teaser: Configurable spawn mod, allows waves / starting PMCs / boss chances / progressive boss chances. ABPS will always try to keep your raids full and different each time.

name: Lotus
teaser: Custom Trader with over 340+ Quests, 900+ sold and bartered items and a special keycard that gives infinite labs access.

name: Search Open Containers
teaser: Allow searching open containers without needing to close them first

name: Gilded Key Storage
teaser: A balanced progression based approach to convenient all in one key storage!

name: The Blacklist - flea market enhancements
teaser: Disables the B** blacklist in the flea market. Rebalances the prices of blacklisted ammo like Igolnik. Speeds up sell times for offers. Additional configs to set flea prices for any item in the game.

name: HandsAreNotBusy
teaser: Annoyed by the ancient "Hands are busy" bug? HandsAreNotBusy (HANB) is a mod that can fix certain scenarios of the "Hands are busy" bug for you!

name: Quest Tracker
teaser: Track quests while in-raid with a handy toggleable overlay!

name: bluehead's AIO Trader
teaser: Buy everything from one trader. Get all keys with one command.

name: Continuous Healing
teaser: Tired of having to heal every limb one by one? Now you can heal them all in one go until done or manually cancelled!

name: Scorpion
teaser: Scorpion has 122 quests available from the start of your T***** journey. Including time based event quests!

name: Quick Move To Containers
teaser: Quickly move items between your inventory or stash, and any open container(s)

name: Classic Movement
teaser: Completely removes any inertia and slowed down movement, and replaces it with the official much faster movement from 12.10

name: Weapon Customizer
teaser: Personalize your weapon! Adjust rails and attachment positioning.

name: BrightLasers
teaser: Brighter lasers for your guns. No more blue laser, best laser. (It's still the best)

name: MoreBotsAPI
teaser: API for making the implementation of custom bots easier

name: WTT - Menu Overhaul
teaser: Add a new menu layout to SPT and add your player to the menu screen.

name: Increase Climb Height
teaser: Increases the height at which you can perform a climb.

name: Use Items Anywhere
teaser: Use and bind items from anywhere in your inventory

name: WTT - Black Division [REDACTED] Home
teaser: [REDACTED]

name: Trader Modding And Improved Weapon Building
teaser: Weapon modding 2.0: Checkbox to only show current Trader LL / owned mods, Shows Trader/Flea Prices/Build Cost, Adds Quick Buy Button, Adds Button to detach items in use, Highlights mods attached to other guns or ready to use, Ability to zoom in/out.

name: Color Converter API
teaser: Client-side mod to allow using hexcode colors for your items! Custom background colors for your items, or any color tracer you want!

name: Use Loose Loot
teaser: Use meds and food direct from the world instead of only your pockets. ;)

name: Rai's Hidden Caches
teaser: Adds a flare-like effect to all of the hidden stashes on the map! Smoke, lighting, and audio will emit from all the random secret caches to help you find them! Effects can be customized and toggled.

name: AutoDeposit
teaser: Transfer items into stash containers with matching items, inspired by Terraria's Quick Stack.

name: Player Encumbrance Bar
teaser: Adds a progress bar to the inventory that shows total player encumbrance

name: Project Fika
teaser: Project Fika is a mod designed to enable co-op multiplayer game play with your friends in SPT. You can progress through quests, share items and quest progression, fight AI bots (PMCs, SCAVs, and bosses) together and much more.

name: Continuous Load Ammo
teaser: You are now able to continuously load or unload ammo outside your inventory!

name: VRAM Cleaner
teaser: Clears up unused assets after raid start timer finishes

name: WTT - Head and Voice Selector
teaser: Customize your character's voice and head appearance post-creation using new dropdown boxes in the Overall panel.

name: Healing Autocancel
teaser: Healing Autocancel

name: Task List Fixes
teaser: Do you want to fix sorting, improve sorting, and improve performance? Grab Task List Fixes and you'll get it all in one simple DLL

name: MergeConsumables
teaser: Tired of not being able to merge your medical items or food? Now you can!

name: Amands' Sense - Updated
teaser: Interactable icons for items, containers, bodies and extracts.

name: Climbable Ladders
teaser: Ladders

name: Fast Sell In Flea
teaser: Quickly add items on the flea market with automatic fitting of the current price

name: Shadow Flicker Fix
teaser: Fixes distant shadow flickering which was most noticeable with anti-aliasing disabled.

name: More Energy Drinks
teaser: Adds 38 unique energy drinks that range in rarity and provide interesting effects that your PMC can enjoy during raids. Now you can share your caffeine addiction with your PMC!

name: give-ui
teaser: Simple UI for the give, trader and profile commands

name: MANIMAL'S ICEBREAKER BACKPORT
teaser: A mod that backports the entire Icebreaker map and some of its related quests to SPT

name: Open Sesame
teaser: A tool for developers (and cheaters) to open locked doors, safes, etc. without requiring the key

name: Bot Callsigns - Reloaded
teaser: Adds a big (and sometimes funny) variety of bot names for flea and game.

name: Simple Workout QTE
teaser: Workout QTE in hideout is now much easier, and configurable!

name: HarryHideout
teaser: Trader that sells all items for hideout construction/upgrades

name: Brighter Interiors
teaser: Tweak darkness of interior shadows to your taste

name: Modding Stats Helper - by wara
teaser: Adds a tooltip when hovering parts in the weapon building screen that shows a quick overview of relevant stats and comparisons.

name: Ai Limit
teaser: Temporarily disable far bots to reduce cpu load

name: All Quests Checkmarks
teaser: Tired of having to remember what items you have to keep for future quests? This mod adds new checkmarks for items that are required in future quests. It also works with Fika and shows items required by your friends!

name: Better Keys NG
teaser: Get some useful info about each key. Is it required for a quest? What is behind the lock? Is it used to exit/transit ?

name: Deminvincibility
teaser: A standalone version of DadGamerMode's Keep 1 Health section with extended settings.

name: Enable Labyrinth
teaser: Enables Labyrinth for PMCs and Scavs. Adds a custom exfil point for Scavs at the same location as the non-secret exfil for PMCs. Requirements for entry are removed.

name: Content Backport - Prestiges
teaser: Already at prestige 4 and want to grind more? Then this mod is for you!

name: Simple Crosshair
teaser: A pointfire/hipfire crosshair for all the non-purists among us.

name: Audio Accessibility Indicators
teaser: Hard of hearing? Deaf? This mod will even the playing field without being straight up radar. Each shot, sprint, sneak, voiceline or run audio played within a configurable range will draw an indicator on your screen dictating which direction.

name: Skills Extended
teaser: Lack of skills is no longer a skill issue

name: Raid Review
teaser: A web-based post raid replay system of your SPT raids; detailed replay system with heatmap overlay, review kills, lootings, positional data, and just get a general understanding of what was going on in your raids!

name: Hideout In Progress
teaser: Turn in items for hideout construction as you get them!

name: Better Rear Sights
teaser: This mod attempts to make iron sights less crappy

name: BossNotifier
teaser: v1.2.1 out now! Know which bosses spawned in your raid! Get notifications at spawn with locations.

name: ALL AMMO TRADER - UPDATED BY TILTUSHKIN
teaser: Need all the ammo? Here's a trader

name: BarterItemsStacks
teaser: A mod that changes the stack size for barter items.. And a little more…

name: ORBIT 2.0
teaser: Bots play the raid like you do, and a "Ghost Mode" to run it all at high fps

name: WTT - W.A.A.C. (Women's Advanced Assault Corps)
teaser: Did you know? There are HOT, SINGLE women in your AO that are ready for INTENSE tactical ops?

name: Freecam
teaser: A flying free camera mode for EFT

name: Headshot Darkness
teaser: Instant feedback for when you get head, eyes'd.

name: ODT's Item Info - SPT 4.0
teaser: Massive QOL Item Info mod for SPTarkov

name: Camo And Stickers
teaser: New era of Drip

name: Couturier - gear and clothing pack
teaser: Backpacks, helmets, armors and chestrigs (retextures) + trader for them + some clothing

name: Door Randomizer
teaser: Getting tired of doors always being in the same state at raid start? Randomize them instead!

name: Make Shotguns Great Again!
teaser: New attachments, new guns, and key rebalances. Also introduces specialized cartridges to shotguns, including the Dragon's Breath and .700 Nitro.

name: Late to the Party
teaser: Make your SPT experience closer to live T***** with loot disappearing, doors opening, switches being turned on, and car extracts leaving throughout the raid. Bosses will also be less likely to spawn during Scav raids.

name: Foldables
teaser: You can now fold backpacks and vests!

name: Health Per Level
teaser: Increase health depending on player level

name: StatTrack
teaser: Ever wanted to know how many kills and headshots you have with a specific weapon? Now you can. All weapons will individually track their kills and headshots and display on the info screen for the weapon. See how many you can rack up before you die!

name: Wolfik's Heavy Trooper Masks
teaser: Adds 5 new heavy trooper masks: Tan, Black, Coyote, Wolf, and Cult that actually provide protection

name: Project Fika - Server
teaser: Server component for the Fika mod.

name: Bosses Have Gp Coins
teaser: From the maker of Bosses Have Lega Medals! Now... the exact same mod, but with Gp Coins. Such wow. Amazing.

name: C11 - True North
teaser: New guns and parts from foreign lands

name: SPT Mods Installer
teaser: A simple little application that allows drag-and-dropping mods in zip formats.

name: Definitive Weapon Variants
teaser: 600+ weapon variants based on existing guns. Whether you want an automatic version of your favourite weapon, click scavs to death, tap bosses with anti-materiel rifles, or simply collect unique variants, this mod has it all!

name: NerfBotGrenades
teaser: Allows you to multiply bot inaccuracy with grenades.

name: QuickSellFlea
teaser: Tired of placing orders on the flea? Tired of having to install 20 mods to quick sell on flea? Now you can instantly place it with the average price - with just ONE click and no other mods needed!

name: Croupier - loadout generator + flea quicksell
teaser: Gear up for your next raid in just 20 seconds!

name: UNTAR Go Home!
teaser: Yet they're still here in T*****... New UNTAR bot types patrol the region.

name: Lacy's PvE Tweaks
teaser: Several options to make PvE less annoying. Want to go to Labyrinth without using the transit? Now you can queue right into it! Want to make quests less grindy, or less restrictive? Now you can!

name: Exfil Flare Notification
teaser: A small QoL mod for folks that are paranoid if their exfil flare was used correctly

name: BALANCED MEDS
teaser: All the meds item are changed. Increased uses and better healing.

name: Skill Distribution
teaser: Want to level your skills faster but also want to keep vanilla feel of progression? Give this mod a try, you might like it.

name: RUAF Come Home!
teaser: RUAF have finally returned to resolve the Norvinsk conflict.

name: Repair Max Durability
teaser: Literally just adds an item that repairs the max durability of weapons
